# Jawsh’s Gaming Diary — early-mission impressions

- Original title: Diary Entry #38: PC Prospects and GOOD GOD MY GIRLFRIEND IS AWESOME!
- Source: [Original publication](https://jawshplaysgames.blogspot.com/2014/07/diary-entry-38-pc-prospects-and-good.html)
- Author / publisher: jawshplaysgames
- Language / date: English; 2014-07-21
- Access: Robin Hood section and publication metadata inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

The diary singles Robin Hood out as the most enjoyable game in a multi-game PC session. The writer describes sneaking beside guards, knocking one out, fighting multiple opponents, and receiving equipment after rescuing a villager.

The emphasis is on how stealth, positioning, and melee combine in small encounters. Automatic blocking makes combat feel simple to this player, but maneuvering through situations remains satisfying. These are early-play impressions rather than a completed-campaign review. The accompanying images were not visually inspected, and the exact build and difficulty are unspecified.
